changelog:
SHANEX Print Manager Pro v5.0.11

- Fix repeated WhatsApp/watcher queue imports and notifications after acknowledgement failures.
- Load and reconcile only the selected customer's folder; avoid historical file inspection at Windows watcher startup.
- Restore incoming-file visibility in deferred customer queues and preserve printing settings, selection, unread indicators and Force Select review.
- Fix the local deferred-save/hydration baseline race that could produce false standalone save conflicts.
- Back off failed file inspections, retain recoverable inbox records and include source paths/message IDs in diagnostics.
- Keep the SHANEX-branded Windows installer and interactive removal of registered older versions.

Installer is unsigned. Live WhatsApp/UNC recovery, legacy-upgrade acceptance, sustained idle CPU and physical printing validation remain pending. Rescan/profile-script errors and unexplained window closures are not claimed fixed.
